entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Bob. How can I help you today?
Hi Bob, I'd like to make a return. I bought some road cycling shoes a while back and they're just not working out for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Got it, one moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 49 days ago. Let me just check the policy here... yep, our return window is **10 days**, so that's **no problem** at all.
Oh, fantastic! I wasn't sure if it had been too long. So what do I do next?

I've just processed the request. I'm sending you a pre-paid **return label** to your email on file right now. You just need to print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off with the post.
That's it? That's so easy. Thank you!
You're very welcome! Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Anything else I can assist with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again for your help, Bob.
It was my pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
